items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: But I had my old poor dad who was living them days. And he used to have to parade.

ctx.x: Yeah it's May the 30th. I wish that semester would still remain but it destroyed. Don't use it no more. It has to be a great day Armstead Day. Since it's May the 30th. And like September. First Monday in September used to be Labor Day. And during those days there used to be great days. But I had my old poor dad who was living them days. And he used to have to parade. Which is called the Long Charmette. Nobody would work harder. No working people would wake them days. That's way back. That's way back around 1914.…
What bands did they have on the riverboat?
